proposal: The Mandate recommends that HHS reinstate the Trump-era regulation enforcing Section 1303 of the ACA, which requires insurers to collect a separate payment for non-Hyde abortion coverage in exchange plans and to hold it in separate accounts, and strengthen it by requiring CMS to ensure consumers pay truly separate charges (p. 473).
